values.note: Water and electric at the 30 standard sites; two full-hookup sites add sewer. The park advisory says the reopened campground has 50-amp service.

hookups.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/baker-creek/camping (advisory 'THE CAMPGROUND IS NOW OPEN! With two new family-style comfort stations and 50-amp service'; 'Standard Sites with Elec. & Water: 30 standard sites'; 'Full Hookup Sites with Elec, Water, Sewer: 2 full hookup sites'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 30 standard water/electric sites, 2 full-hookup sites and 1 designated tent site along Lake Thurmond (the camping page also calls it a '34-site campground'; the reservation site says 33 campsites for tents and RVs). No site lengths published.

sites.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/baker-creek/camping ('A 34-site campground is located along the shores of Strom Thurmond Lake'; 30 standard + 2 full hookup + 1 tent site) + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/baker-creek/campsites ('The park offers 33 campsites that accommodate both tent camping and RVs'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/baker-creek/camping ('convenient to restrooms with hot showers'; Dump Station: Yes; 'No Wifi Available'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; per AWH's firsthand report on the agency row, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. Maximum 14 nights per site (42 of 49 cumulative). Same-day reservations go through the park. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/baker-creek/camping ('Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; same-day via the park) + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/baker-creek/campsites (policies: 'Reservations may be made up to 13 months in advance', 'Minimum length of stay is 2 nights', 'Maximum length of stay is 14 nights per site', check-in 2:00 p.m.), read 2026-10-21; single-night phone waiver from the state:SC row's AWH firsthand note

summary: Confirmed reservable on SC's own site, 13-month window, 2-night minimum (with the AWH phone waiver) and 14-night max, now on the entry. Added 50 A + water at every site and sewer at 2 full-hookup sites, 33 sites, showers, dump, no Wi-Fi. Campground reopened (advisory: 'THE CAMPGROUND IS NOW OPEN!'); trails closed for logging/Helene. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Note kept. Not stated: site lengths, season, pull-throughs.
